record.paper_title: Known results and open problems in hypercomplex convexity
record.original_question: Let M^n be an n-dimensional manifold such that for every hyperplane L, the section M^n ∩ L is homeomorphic to the (n−1)-dimensional sphere S^{n−1}. Must M^n itself be homeomorphic to the n-dimensional sphere S^n?

evidence.quote:
Ulam problem. LetM n be n-dimensional manifold and every section of
M n by hyperplanes L be homeomorphic to (n− 1)-dimensional sphere Sn−1.
Is it true that M n is n-dimensional sphere?

In the real case this problem is solved by A. Kosi´ nski in 1962 [12]. The
repetition of this result was obtained by L. Montejano in 1990 [13]. In complex
case similar result was obtained by Yu. Zelinskii in 1993 [7].

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $M^n \subset \mathbb{R}^N$ be an $n$-dimensional topological manifold (with $n \geq 2$) embedded in some Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^N$ (with $N \geq n+1$) such that for every affine hyperplane $L \subset \mathbb{R}^N$, the intersection $M^n \cap L$ is either empty or homeomorphic to the $(n-1)$-dimensional sphere $S^{n-1}$. Prove or disprove: $M^n$ must be homeomorphic to the $n$-dimensional sphere $S^n$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem (Ulam's section problem) was resolved affirmatively in the real case by A. Kosiński (1962), with an alternative proof by L. Montejano (1990), and the analogous complex version by Yu. Zelinskii (1993). It is therefore considered solved.

status_evidence.title: Kosiński, A.: A theorem on families of acyclic sets and its applications
status_evidence.snippet: Kosiński proved that an n-manifold all of whose hyperplane sections are (n−1)-spheres is homeomorphic to S^n.
status_evidence.claim: Real case of the Ulam section problem solved by Kosiński (1962).

status_evidence.title: Montejano, L.: A new topological Helly theorem and some transversal results
status_evidence.snippet: Montejano (1990) gave a new proof of the characterization of the sphere by its hyperplane sections.
status_evidence.claim: Independent confirmation of the result by Montejano (1990).
